title: CBIC Clarifies GST Refund Revalidation Rules via Corrigendum (Nov 18, 2026)
content:
# CBIC Clarifies GST Refund Revalidation Rules via Corrigendum (Nov 18, 2026)

Ek important update hai! Government ne CGST Amendment Rules, 2026 mein GST refund revalidation rules ko clarify karne ke liye ek corrigendum announce kiya hai. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne yeh correction 18th November 2026 ko jari kiya hai, which brings much-needed clarity.

*   **Corrigendum Details:** This corrigendum, vide Notification No. G.S.R. 1001(E) dated November 18, 2026, makes corrections to the English version of the Central Goods and Services Tax (Amendment) Rules, 2026, jo originally October 26, 2026, ko publish hue the (G.S.R. 919(E)).
*   **GST Refund Revalidation Clarification:**
    *   Ab, refund orders jo **Form GST RFD-06** mein issue hote hain, unki **revalidation ki zaroorat nahi hogi**.
    *   Lekin, **payment orders in Form GST RFD-05 ko revalidate karna zaroori hoga** agar refund ussi financial year mein disburse nahi hua hai jis mein order issue hua tha.
*   **Other Important Corrections:** Corrigendum mein GST registration documents, terminology (e.g., "permission" replaced with "consent"), and the expression "seven days" being corrected to "seven working days" jaise several other textual and procedural changes bhi kiye gaye hain.

Yeh clarifications businesses ke liye compliance ko thoda easier banayenge, especially refund processing ke mamle mein.
